notes.title: A brand new update!
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

Hope your winter isn't too quiet, and that you're ready for Spring Training! We have a lot of new stuff coming up for this season, and it starts with a small update! But you can expect more to come, with the new Owner free DLC feature, and a new contract negotiation flow! I'm also going to work on improving the UI of more screens.

Complete changelog

 New player portrait picker!
 New portraits for front office coaches and scouts
 Improved UI for the Franchise Player mode
 Improved inbox
 Bug fix for relivers


As usual, feel free to share your feedback about this update on Steam, or by email!
See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: The Minor League Update
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

We're glad to present you our latest update for Astonishing Baseball Manager: a new complete minor team system!

Historically, in AB, you could only send major leaguers to your minor team, and only manage those, disregarding the other members of the team. No more!
Your minor team will now display every minor leaguer in it, allowing you to see their progress through time, and calling them up if you find them promising!

We're also introducing some UI improvements and bug fixes, in order to improve even more your baseball experience!

Complete changelog

 New minor team system
 UI improvements for the front office, the draft, the offseason and more
 Bug fixes for achievements, the draft, superstars and relievers


See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: Spring Training Update
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

While we're waiting for the new season to start, a new update has been pushed! It mostly contains bug fixes, including one for the franchise player mode that a lot of people were waiting for!
It also includes some small simulation improvements, and some UI niceties for the multiplayer mode.

Astonishing Baseball Manager 24 is on the horizon as well, and I'll share more news in the upcoming weeks.

See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: Postseason update
notes.notes:
Hi baseball fans!

The season is not over yet! We have a big update, ready just for you! That includes new rosters, new records for the awards screen, stylish new team logos, and a brand new community-inspired shop for your stadium!

Here is what you can expect in this exciting update:

Improvements and changes

 Our rosters have been updated!
 Show off with style thanks to the brand new team logos!
 Team records have been added to the awards screen.
 The Astonishing Zoo is here, ready to make your ballpark even better!
 Improved injury management for minor team players
 Defense and IP are now available as lineup stats.
 Legends can now become superstars!
 Bug fixes for the ballpark, starter display and women leagues
 New help sections about pitching and batting attributes


Feel free to let us know if you have any feedback or issue on this version.
See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: The All-Star Update
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

I'm glad to announce our brand new update for Astonishing Baseball! It brings most of the upgrades from the AB23 engine, which means plenty of new features for all of you!

Here's an overview of the main changes, but you'll probably notice a few more.

Improvements and changes

 A brand new UI all over the game :o
 New portraits for your front office colleagues
 Improved help sections
 A third column has been added to the pitchers in the lineup screen
 The draft pick and round of players is now displayed in their info dialog
 More info are being displayed in the history screen and the league records
 New search options
 Your assistant might now give you small bonus tasks for TP
 A new transactions page now summarize all your recent trades
 You can now mass-recall your minor team players
 Your minor team can now be customized even more than before
 Improved franchise player UI



I hope you will enjoy these new features! And if you have any trouble, feel free to send us a support email.

See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: The Astonishing Baseball 23 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

I'm proud to announce our biggest update of the year! Astonishing Baseball for Steam has finally received a big engine update. Which means better AI, better simulations, and plenty of new features!

This is the first of two major updates we'll release this year. Another big update is being prepared, and will be available this summer. 

If you see anything unusual in this update, or if you have any suggestions, feel free to drop me an email!

Meanwhile, here's the complete changelog of this big update!

New features


 A new award: the “Most Improved Player” trophy!
 Players will now become friends or rivals with their teammates, generating messages from the bleachers
 Players will now send you message from time to time to share what’s on their mind
 Grades have been added to the lineup screen, to make it easier for beginners to start
 Completely revamped AI for free agents


Improvements and changes


 Bug fixes for international scouting
 Fully training a player will now give them a +1 potential bonus, if they still have potential left
 Legendary players you receive from the shop will now always be young
 The Hall of Fame team selection process has been improved, which means players won’t always join their last team anymore
 Reaching certain milestones as a coach will trigger messages
 Defense is now considered when pricing contracts
 New meta for contract negotiation
 More players will now appear as potential front office members


See you at the ballpark!
Aerilys

notes.title: The franchise player update!
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans! Happy new year!

Let's start 2023 the right way: with a brand new game mode! 
The Franchise Player mode allows you to play the career of your very own batter. Join a team and help it win the Baseball Cup, or go from city to city as a journeyman. Sign with prestigious sponsors, and collect the best bats in the world!

This is a beta feature for now, so you can expect a few issues. If you encounter any problem, or have any suggestion, feel free to drop me an email!

We have more in store for Astonishing Baseball in 2023. Thanks for being part of this adventure!

notes.title: November Update
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

Long time no see! The season is over, but not our cycle of updates! So this week, I'm bringing you a bunch of bug fixes, and the brand new custom colors interface. You will now be able to create your own custom colors to use for your team and user interface. 
Sounds good? Check out the new custom colors section in the game settings!


 Custom color creation tool, so you can personalize your team with the color of your choice!
 A few bug fixes for stadiums, contracts and the prodigy


The Franchise player update is still being worked on, but believe me, it's close!

Enjoy the offseason, and see you at the ballpark (maybe?)

Hey baseball fans!

This week we have a big update: the new rosters are now available! But that's not all. 
You certainly have noticed that we have new artworks for our Steam listing!

notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

This week is all about small details! 
First of all, the season screen has been redesigned with a cleaner look, and smaller cells for the scoreboard section. Look at this beauty!

notes.title: A Prodigious Update!
notes.notes:
Hi baseball fans!

This week we bring you a big update, with not one but two major features!
The first one is "The Prodigy". In this mini-mode, you will take care of a future prospect, going from high school all the way to your graduation! Not only you have to take care of upgrading their stats, but also take very important decisions: do you train or study? Do you go to a college in Seattle or Paris? Do you play baseball or go out with your teammates? And most importantly, should you go to the Halloween party with your best friend or the girl of your dreams? There's no wrong answer (or so they say).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/70824dc6813c868859156548d8143199a9236f03.png

The second new feature is the ability to go deeper in the training of your players. Until now, training was only improving hitting or pitching. But now, you can choose to also train power, speed, or the accuracy of your pitchers! Of course, all your previous training is still there, and keeps the same efficiency. This means that the new system just allows you to make your players even better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/0b7e9db13badf89c0d6406929abfcce1d8f839cc.png

Finally, remember to check out the amazing God Mode DLC if you haven't yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2082240/Astonishing_Baseball__God_Mode/

More is to come, so stay around for next week's update!
See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: The Superstar update
notes.notes:
Hey baseball fans!

We finally got some good news last week, and I'm sure all of you will be happy to enjoy baseball in the upcoming days. But if you find yourself with some downtime, maybe you will want to try the new Superstar feature! 

With this new update, whenever you have a fully-trained All-star, you can decide to turn him/her into a superstar, which would give them unique perks, like an extra defense point, or the lifetime contract!

Play ball!

New features

 The superstar feature, allowing you to get unique perks for your favorite player
 Revamped search UI, allowing you to search players in real-time!
 The task "It's a long season" will now give more training points
 Improved experience for new players

notes.title: V1.03 - Scripted Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow baseball fans!

Let's start the week the right way with a new update for Astonishing Baseball! Thanks to your feedback, I've been able to fix a number of bugs. But because I didn't want to just ship fixes, I thought it would be cool to add a new feature as well. So here are scenarios!

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/533101174988210177/935193398749581323/AB21_5D8ECA6.jpg

Scenarios are new ways to enjoy the game. You can either decide to travel in time and play as an old dynasty, or try to beat one of the available challenges. The latest include The Detroit Challenge, which is an excellent way to actually test your skills!

Thank you to everybody for your support, and keep sending me feedback! Also, special thanks to Andy, who's been incredibly helpful since the release of the game. Also special mention to Nightkeep3r and Aton, my special Steam advisors on Discord ;)

Have an astonishing week!


Complete Changelog
Improvements

 The stadium's back button will now stay in place instead of scrolling
 The draft page will now scroll up when switching between batters and pitchers
 The search screen can now return up to 99 results (instead of 50)
 A button will now appear when an international prospect is available
 The max length of a city's name during the save creation has been doubled to 32 characters
 When adding a custom logo to your team in the front office page, the custom logo will now appear right after the info have been saved
 The position of the top menu in main screens is now fixed instead of jumping all over the place


Bug Fixes

 The minor team screen can now scroll when you have a lot of players
 Improved display of hits during a game
 Scroll for the bullpen dialog
 No more mention of multiplayer for now ;)
 Scouts XP are now correctly saved
 Typos

notes.title: Road to release
notes.notes:
Astonishing Baseball 21 will soon be available on Steam, and you might even receive a demo soon if you're a lucky one!

But first, let's talk about some of the big upcoming changes in this edition!

Career mode
This very popular feature allows you to manage your reputation as a manager, and change teams when you wish... Or when you're forced to! Will you lead a dynasty to victory, or try to rebuild a small-market team? That's your choice!

Expanded history
In baseball, the past is as important as the future. In this edition, you will be able to see a complete history of past seasons. No matter if you want to remember who the MVP was that year, or if you want to check the history of a veteran before signing him!

Improved minor team
The new minor team system allows you to hire a coach to improve your minor team, and then train rookies over time. Will you leave your new rookie starter in the farm system to improve in peace, or will you call him up right away? That's your choice!

Become the world champion
Every years, the best players in the universe compete in the World Cup! And you might be called up to coach that team! Will you help the Oceania Explorers to win it all, or join the US Eagles?

Fan service
You can now write your own bleachers message. Boost your players confidence, or ask your fanbase which player they prefer thanks to the new poll feature. You're now GM, coach, and community manager. Congrats!



And this is just some of the features you will be able to enjoy. There are many more, like the Power Contest, the league records, or the new coaching staff. But that will be for another time!
